chunks: 5915 - And it was narrated to us by ʿAbd al-Wāḥid ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdūs al-Naysābūrī, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn Qutaybah narrated to us from al-Faḍl ibn Shādhān, who said: I heard al-Riḍā عليه السلام saying:

“When the head of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام was carried to al-Shām, Yazīd, may Allah curse him, ordered, and it was placed, and a table was set over it. Then he and his companions came forward eating and drinking al-fuqqāʿ. When they had finished, he ordered the head to be placed in a basin beneath a couch, and the cloth of chess was spread over it. Yazīd, may Allah curse him, then sat playing chess, mentioning al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī, his father, and his grandfather, upon them السلام, and mocking their mention. Whenever he gambled with his companion, he would take al-fuqqāʿ and drink it three times, then pour what remained of it onto the ground near the basin. So whoever is among our Shīʿah, let him refrain from drinking al-fuqqāʿ and from playing chess. And whoever looks at al-fuqqāʿ or at chess, let him remember al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام and curse Yazīd and the family of Ziyād. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, thereby erases his sins, even if they were as numerous as the stars.”

key_terms.آلَ زِيَادٍ: The family of Ziyad, mentioned here in condemnation.
key_terms.الشَّامِ: The region of Syria, where the head was taken.
key_terms.الْفُقَّاعَ: A fermented beverage mentioned here as something to be avoided.
key_terms.ذُنُوبَهُ: His sins, which Allah erases through this act of remembrance and disavowal.
key_terms.رَأْسُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: The blessed head of Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام after Karbala.
key_terms.رُقْعَةُ الشِّطْرَنْجِ: The chessboard cloth spread out for the game of chess.
key_terms.شِيعَتِنَا: The followers and adherents of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about chess, al-fuqqa', and remembering Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts the desecration committed by Yazid after the martyrdom of Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام and links that memory to a prohibition against drinking al-fuqqa' and playing chess. It also instructs the Shia to remember Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام and to disavow Yazid and آل زياد when encountering these acts, as a means of seeking forgiveness.
